reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text:
A little more pigmented than anticipated, but as I'm quite fair and have a a rosy undertone to my skin, it evens it out quite a lot before putting on makeup. It does absorb though, and the colour isn't as noticeable once it does, but it does take a minute to absorb.

I haven't noticed any weird separation with my foundation (tirtir red cushion) whenever I wear it over this suncream, but I don't know how it'll react if other foundations.
reviews.zh:
比我預期中有少少顏色，但係我膚色幾白，而且底調偏粉紅，所以用咗之後，喺化妝前令膚色均勻咗好多。佢會被吸收，被吸收之後顏色就冇咁明顯，不過要等一陣子先吸收晒。

每次我喺呢款防曬上面用 tirtir red cushion 粉底，都冇見到有奇怪嘅分層，但係我唔知用其他粉底會點。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text: well worth a shot even for medium/deepish skin tones…takes too long for that white cast to melt in though so i ended up giving it to my mom who is like a porcelain doll and it really toned and brightened her skin up noticeably. definitely could have used it but im just too lazy (-_-)
reviews.zh: 就算係中至偏深膚色都值得一試……不過佢個白色殘留要好耐先吸收，所以我最後俾咗畀我媽媽，佢膚色好白，好似瓷娃娃咁，用咗之後膚色明顯均勻、亮咗好多。我其實都可以用，但係我太懶 (-_-)

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text: My go-to sunscreen!! Been using it for almost 3 years and I don't think I can do without it anymore!! I don't even need to use foundation because it covers my pores so well!! 🫶🏻
reviews.zh: 我嘅首選防曬！！用咗差不多三年，我諗我已經離唔開佢啦！！我甚至唔需要用粉底，因為佢遮蓋毛孔嘅效果好好！！ 🫶🏻

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text: The tone-up really works, although it’s very light, so it might look odd on darker skin tones. The texture is a bit heavy and fragranced, so I prefer to use it when I don’t want to wear makeup (my skin feels heavy with both on). It leaves the skin soft and minimizes pores. It works well with my sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 提亮效果真係有用，雖然顏色好淺，所以喺較深膚色上可能會睇落怪怪地。質地有少少厚身同有香味，所以我會喺唔想化妝嗰日先用（兩樣一齊用令我皮膚覺得好重）。佢令皮膚柔軟，亦令毛孔不明顯。佢對我嘅敏感皮膚都幾好。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text:
For my skin tone, it’s so great for a no-makeup day when I still have zoom calls. However, the white-cast on any skin darker than me must be insane. It’s there for me at first but then settles down into a beautiful, even, glowy finish.
For the pale folks, this is a must-have. For anyone else, unfortunately, I don’t see how it would work for you.
reviews.zh:
以我嘅膚色嚟講，喺唔化妝但仲要開 Zoom 會議嗰日，呢款好好用。不過，比我深色嘅皮膚，白色殘留一定好誇張。一開始係會見到，但之後會沉澱成一種漂亮、均勻、有光澤嘅效果。
對於膚色好白嘅人，呢款係必備。不過對其他人，我就唔知佢點樣啱你。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text: product has some floral smell that's just too strong for my tolerance level. tone up is much more brighter than i expected initially but it blends back naturally after a while. wont repurchase due to smell
reviews.zh: 產品有啲花香，對我嚟講太濃，超出我可以接受嘅範圍。提亮效果比我最初預期嘅更加亮，不過過咗一陣子就會自然咁融返。因為味道，我唔會再買。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text: I wear shade 21 in Korean foundation. This sunscreen feels very greasy to me on application and takes quite a bit of effort to rub in due to how streaky the tone-up is. I do not like how this sunscreen has fragrance. The scent is alright, but I wouldn't want it in a sunscreen. The actual scent has a light feeling, but it's projection is too strong. I would not repurchase this sunscreen. I don't want to use it on my face, so I'll have to use it on the back of my hand to not waste money.
reviews.zh: 我韓國粉底用 21 號色。呢款防曬塗落我覺得好油膩，而且因為提亮色好有條紋，所以要花好多力氣先推得開。我唔鍾意呢款防曬有香味。味道都可以，但係我唔想防曬有味道。香味本身感覺輕，但係散發力太強。我唔會再買呢款防曬。我唔想喺面上用，所以我要喺手背上用，咁就唔會浪費錢。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Vita Tone Up Sun Cream 50mL
reviews.text: I am a warm tone girly, but I will use this as my sun cream on days when I want to be a cool tone girly (ie. wear black clothes and silver jewelry). It really helps to bring harmony for me on those days. I really love this one, but it does have a little bit of a perfume scent, which doesn't bother me but I can see it being a problem for other people.
reviews.zh: 我係暖色調嘅女生，但係我會喺想變成冷色調女生嘅日子（即係着黑色衣服、戴銀色首飾）用呢款防曬。嗰啲日子佢真係幫我帶嚟和諧感。我真係好鍾意呢款，但係佢有少少香水味，對我冇影響，但係我諗對其他人嚟講可能會成問題。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
